root_cause: Multiple independent merge-queue jobs (NPU Models Tests for platforms 4000/6010, TensorFlow Layer Tests) all failed at the 'Download OpenVINO artifacts (wheels)' step with an identical error: the GitHub Actions blob storage backend stopped responding mid-download, tripping a 30-second per-chunk timeout after 5 retries. This is the same signature recorded ~21 minutes earlier for run 34205188404 (PR #38007), indicating an ongoing GitHub Actions/Azure Blob Storage transient degradation rather than an issue caused by PR #37208's GPU clang-tidy brace changes (which touch only .hpp header formatting, unrelated to artifact storage).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; transient GitHub Actions artifact storage backend issue.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs; a plain retry is expected to succeed once the blob storage backend recovers.

If retries continue to fail across multiple merge-queue runs, check the GitHub Status page (githubstatus.com) for an ongoing Actions/Artifacts incident and consider pausing merge-queue processing until resolved.
No code changes are required in PR #37208.
prevention_strategies: Add retry/backoff wrapping around the artifact download action, or split large artifacts (openvino_wheels) into smaller pieces to reduce the chance of a single chunk stalling past the 30s timeout window.
historical_context: Identical signature (bd5ee42b01f94f83) first recorded 2026-09-08T10:02:37Z for run 34205188404 (PR #38007), only ~21 minutes before this run. This is the 2nd occurrence; a related but distinct upload-side blob storage error was recorded 2026-09-04 (pattern 841a57c639e28d01, PR #37898).
